blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-accessibility-1 (Delete action is a clickable div, unreachable by keyboard) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-accessibility-2 (Icon-only delete control has no accessible name) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Render the delete action as a native `<button type="button" className="icon-button" onClick={onDelete}>`. The div has no role, no tabindex and no key handler: a keyboard user pressing Tab never reaches it, and Enter or Space cannot trigger it, so a keyboard-only owner cannot delete a document — the change's only purpose. Screen readers do not expose it as a control either. WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.
findings.title: Delete action is a clickable div, unreachable by keyboard

findings.recommendation: Give the control a text name, e.g. `aria-label="Delete document"` on the button (or visually hidden text). Its only content is `TrashIcon`, whose `<svg>` is `aria-hidden="true"` (src/components/icons.tsx:3), so even once it is a `<button>` a screen reader announces just "button": the user cannot tell that it deletes the document. WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.
findings.title: Icon-only delete control has no accessible name

findings.recommendation: Add a text alternative naming the owner (e.g. `alt={`${ownerName}'s avatar`}`, which needs the owner's name as a prop), or `alt=""` if the owner is named elsewhere in the toolbar. Without `alt`, screen readers read the image URL or file name instead of who owns the document. WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content.
findings.title: Owner avatar image has no alt attribute

findings.recommendation: The `.icon-button` styles are not in the diff and the icon is 16 by 16. Check that the control is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels (or spaced enough) and keeps a visible focus indicator once it is focusable. WCAG 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum), 2.4.7 Focus Visible.
findings.title: Focus style and target size of the icon button are not visible in the change
